blocks.en: Three protectants run through one pipeline: the peptide BoPEP4, the folded protein LEA14 and the enzyme ACC deaminase. Each arrives as a sequence and leaves as coordinates with a grade attached. GRAFT predicts the complex a molecule forms with whatever it has to act on, grades that prediction against experimental structure where one exists, and hands the verdict back to design. It answers whether a molecule can engage its partner; whether that engagement produces a biological response is a question for the bench. Five stages, each built around one or two load-bearing modules, with supporting tools feeding them and a redesign loop running back from the verdict.

blocks.en: The limits are part of the model. A well-scored, stereochemically clean complex says the sequence is capable of the molecular recognition step: the one thing this kind of modeling is able to answer. It does not say the peptide is taken up, survives the apoplast, or that binding fires the downstream immune output. Pattern-triggered immunity is read out in the cell, not in the coordinates, so the redesign loop can only ever optimize for predicted binding, never for function.

blocks.zh: 限制本身就是模型的一部分。一個分數良好、立體化學乾淨的複合體，說的是這條序列有能力完成分子辨識這一步：這也是這類建模唯一能回答的事。它沒有說胜肽會被吸收、能在質外體中存活，或結合就會觸發下游的免疫輸出。模式觸發免疫（pattern-triggered immunity）是在細胞裡讀出來的，不是在座標裡，所以重新設計的迴路只能為預測的結合最佳化，永遠不能為功能最佳化。

blocks.en: Computational tools give real insight into protein engineering and act as decision-making engines for wet lab work, but the process is easy to oversimplify: convenient analysis of inputs and outputs in place of thorough analysis, and no methodology tailored to the project it serves.
blocks.text: Computational tools give real insight into protein engineering and act as decision-making engines for wet lab work, but the process is easy to oversimplify: convenient analysis of inputs and outputs in place of thorough analysis, and no methodology tailored to the project it serves.

blocks.en: Their outputs depend heavily on the quality of inputs, parameters and underlying assumptions, and that dependence is worse for short, disordered peptides such as Brassica oleracea Plant Elicitor Peptide 4 (BoPEP4), one of our three protectants alongside Late Embryogenesis Abundant protein 14 (LEA14) and 1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylate deaminase (ACC deaminase). A workflow that holds up has to account for how and why these tools generate their predictions, not merely run them.
blocks.text: Their outputs depend heavily on the quality of inputs, parameters and underlying assumptions, and that dependence is worse for short, disordered peptides such as Brassica oleracea Plant Elicitor Peptide 4 (BoPEP4), one of our three protectants alongside Late Embryogenesis Abundant protein 14 (LEA14) and 1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylate deaminase (ACC deaminase). A workflow that holds up has to account for how and why these tools generate their predictions, not merely run them.

blocks.en: The same workflow runs on all three protectants, with the evidence available deciding how far each one gets. For BoPEP4 it predicts and evaluates the ternary signaling complex of the receptor-like kinase PEPR1, the co-receptor kinase BAK1 and the peptide itself. For LEA14 it co-folds the protein against its F-box partner AtPP2-B11, with ASK1 added as a third chain. For ACC deaminase it works from a crystal structure of the enzyme with cofactor and substrate bound, and the engineering question is stability, not recognition. The workflow was designed on the principles of integrative structural biology established by Alexandre Bonvin at Utrecht University, whose lab produced most of the software below.

blocks.en: Candidate selection begins with the functional requirement, not with a molecule, and surveys gene families instead of single proteins, because a family groups sequences that arose by duplication and therefore tend to share a mechanism even where triggers differ. Four criteria set the shortlist: mechanism match against the stress actually targeted, assayability in the available wet lab, engineerability, and novelty against risk. Candidates failing one are recorded as considered and excluded, because the exclusions define the design space as much as the selections do.

blocks.en: The best-characterized peptide was not assumed to be the best target. AtPEP1 is known mainly for biotic stress, while the project needed measurable abiotic stress, which weather data and sensors detect well. Drought is prominent in Taiwan and is directly signaled by BoPEP4. Abiotic focus also gives direct plant phenotypes such as root length and biomass, where biotic assays would add a second organism and more confounders.

blocks.en: LEA proteins are associated with abiotic stress and can show substantial intrinsic disorder: some lack a single stable fold and adopt different conformations depending on environment or partner. Ordered or globular members were therefore separated from intrinsically disordered ones, because mutation methods designed for folded proteins cannot be read the same way for disordered peptides, and the family contains both.

blocks.en: The ordered, globular LEA14 was chosen, with demonstrated protection against drought, salinity and osmotic stress. Its defined structure gives a stable scaffold for the protein-protein interactions involved in molecular stabilization. Unlike BoPEP4, it does not depend on recognizing one dedicated receptor; its stabilization function can involve many cellular proteins, so a larger structured protein suits the question better. A disordered LEA would instead act through broader, less specific molecular-shield mechanisms.

blocks.en: Designed substitutions fall into two categories, and the distinction determines how each is justified. Interface substitutions aim to change a contact and are usually drawn from a structurally characterized homolog, so the substituted residue is one already observed to work in that position. Liability substitutions aim to remove a predicted failure mode: a specific chemical feature that a specific process condition is expected to attack.

The C-terminus is off limits: Asn23's free carboxylate is the anchor, and deleting the last residue is documented to compromise binding. Fewer residues to synthesize and export also implies faster secretion, so shortening is a manufacturability gain if binding is retained. The wet lab took this up as a testable claim and is measuring secretion for truncated constructs against wild type.

blocks.en: These address liabilities identified in the sequence, not contacts at an interface. LEA14 contains a single cysteine, Cys58, at the start of β3 with no partner. In the reducing plant cytosol an unpaired thiol is inert, but our route sends the protein through the oxidizing extracellular compartment where it can form intermolecular disulfides and dimerise. C58S substitutes a serine of almost identical size that cannot. The test is a gel run with and without reducing agent, so the hypothesis fails visibly if a paired band persists.

The K-segment is the best-characterized membrane-protection module in the family and occurs in dehydrins, not here. The design fuses one or two K-segments, or Group 3 LEA 11-mer repeats, onto the folded core, giving a stable scaffold with a disordered arm.

blocks.en: The precedent is documented: the mitochondrial LEA protein LEAM is disordered in solution and folds into an amphipathic helix that binds and stabilizes membranes as the cell dries. If the motif confers that behavior instead of the whole protein, grafting it should carry the behavior with it. Two constraints bound the graft: added mass reduces the fraction crossing the cell wall, and every fusion junction is a new site to audit for degron compliance and protease susceptibility.

Removing them does three things at once: removes the most exposed proteolytic target, lowers mass and hydrodynamic radius, and leaves the folded β-sandwich core intact. It is also the negative control for the amphipathicity hypothesis above, so the two constructs read against each other. The test is a trypsin challenge comparing how quickly full-length and truncated bands disappear.

blocks.en: The primary restraint set is contact-derived from 5GR8: every PEPR1 heavy atom against every AtPEP1 heavy atom at 4.5 Å, across both crystallographic copies, unioned. blocks.en: Before committing to full runs, DisVis tests whether a restraint set describes a geometrically possible arrangement at all. It scans every rigid-body placement of one partner around the other and reports how many restraints can be satisfied simultaneously, with the volume of accessible interaction space. Each line in a DisVis file is independent, with no OR grouping, so a broad active set is not expected to be fully satisfiable; what matters is how much of the set and how much space stay consistent, measured against a case where the answer is known.

blocks.en: InterPro places the F-box domain at residues 1–44 and the PP2 lectin-like domain at 92–255, with an unassigned linker between. The F-box is the surface that binds ASK1 inside the SCF complex, so it is not available to LEA14 in the cell. Docking the full chain would let the search place LEA14 on a face that is occupied in vivo, so the input is residues 45–257 with the F-box removed, numbering preserved. That leaves the PP2 lectin domain as the surface under test, which is also the substrate-recognition module by analogy with the solved plant F-box complexes.

blocks.en: BoPEP4's activity is not determined solely by PEPR1. BAK1 is the signaling kinase balancing growth and innate immunity, and PEP perception involves receptor–co-receptor association, so the question asked was whether the predicted BoPEP4–PEPR1 interaction could be accommodated in a PEPR1–BoPEP4–BAK1 complex.

blocks.en: Docking all three components simultaneously was attempted first and did not run, so the binary result was used as a structural starting point instead: a selected PEPR1–BoPEP4 complex was retained as established and treated as one body, and BAK1 was docked onto it on the interface identified during restraint mapping. Resulting models were assessed for steric clashes, interface plausibility and consistency with the restraints.

blocks.en: Two caveats. The ternary run inherits its binary input, so a peptide-register error would propagate uncaught, which is why the binary complex was validated against 5GR8 first. And its two restraint sets are not equally certain: peptide-to-receptor is contact-derived from a solved co-crystal, BAK1-to-receptor transferred from 4MN8 by analogy. The output is a structural hypothesis consistent with the published heterodimerisation biochemistry, not a residue-level prediction.

blocks.en: This stage earned its place by disagreeing. The K18R design rested on Lys18 carrying the largest electrostatic contribution in the peptide; a trajectory found that contact present in 53.7% of frames across a 2.55 to 9.37 Å swing, and the design was withdrawn. blocks.en: HADDOCK score is a weighted sum of energy terms in arbitrary units, designed to rank models within a run. In our own validation it did not track structural accuracy: one cluster ranked fourth by score reproduced none of the native contacts. This is the single most important reason triage exists as a multi-check process. If the score alone were reliable the other four would not be needed. It is used to judge convergence and to rank within a run, never as evidence that a model is correct.

blocks.en: CAPRI is the community standard for grading a predicted complex against a known answer, sorting models into acceptable, medium and high accuracy on contact recovery and ligand placement. It is the only check that measures correctness directly, and it only works where a reference structure exists. For us that is 5GR8. Every protocol change is graded against it, so that any claim about a model with no reference rests on a protocol calibrated on one that has it.

It answers a question the docking score cannot: is this the right size and character for a complex that exists in solution? A model can score well while burying far too little surface to be real.

blocks.en: MolProbity validates the stereochemistry of the coordinates themselves, independent of any docking score. It reports a clashscore for atoms in impossible overlapping positions, rotamer outliers for side chains in conformations real residues do not adopt, and backbone geometry. A model can satisfy every restraint and still be chemically illegal, particularly after the side-chain repacking refinement performs, which is why this check sits outside the energy-based scores.

blocks.en: ViennaRNA was used on the assumption that reducing mRNA secondary-structure stability around the MF001 ribosome binding site and the start codon improves translation initiation. Performance was assessed by minimum free energy and unpaired-probability predictions, with codon adaptation index values against Bacillus subtilis 168 codon usage. Recoding codons 2 to 31 within the SamyQ signal peptide and the early CDS breaks inhibitory structure in the start+15 and SD core regions, making the start site easier for ribosomes to attach to.

blocks.en: Phase 1 held the 93-nt SamyQ sequence static and optimized the first 15 codons of each passenger gene independently across 8000 random synonymous variants, maximizing a balance score of start+15 plus SD core. Phase 2 addressed elongation via CAI and appended a C-terminal 6×His tag; this was the June and July design, and the tag moved to the N-terminus for BoPEP4 constructs ordered after August 16. Full-length optimization degraded initiation by lowering start+15. Phase 3 departed from standard host adaptation by making SamyQ codons 2 to 31 editable, 45 editable codons once the first 15 CDS codons are included, and drew roughly 50 000 random synonymous variants per construct, each fully re-folded, further reducing structure around the initiation site. The larger library is the larger editable region: Phase 1 sampled 8000 draws over the CDS codons alone.

blocks.en: SignalP predicts whether a sequence carries a signal peptide, which secretion pathway it targets, and where signal peptidase cleaves. It is used for two purposes.
